comments.author: egbog
comments.body_html:
Fixed “Trap’s Progressive Stash” template. Inside mod.js on line 24 the character.Bonuses field is formatted incorrectly.

What it is -

character.Bonuses = [ { type: “StashSize”, templateId: constants_1.STANDARD_STASH_ID, }, ]; What it should be -

character.Bonuses = [ { id: “64f5b9e5fa34f11b380756c0”, templateId: constants_1.STANDARD_STASH_ID, type: “StashSize”, }, ]; I’m not sure what exactly the “id” field correlates to. However the one above corresponds to the standard stash inside database/templates/profiles -> Edge Of Darkness.bear.character.Bonuses

-EDIT- seems like the “id” is the specific id of the stash in the hideout according to it’s level. ie. the above is level 1.

64f5b9e5fa34f11b380756c2 is lvl 2,

64f5b9e5fa34f11b380756c4 is lvl 3,

64f5b9e5fa34f11b380756c6 is lvl 4
